profile_text.body:
Miro is a for-profit software company founded in 2011 and headquartered in Amsterdam, Netherlands. The company describes itself as an AI-powered visual platform intended to speed up product development from ideation to launch, with a stated aim of helping teams align, reduce tool fragmentation, and ship products. Its site emphasizes the ability to pull outputs from tools such as Claude and NotebookLM into a shared canvas, where teams can review findings, surface priorities, and push insights back out to roadmaps, specifications, or further AI prompts.

The company's primary AI offering is Miro AI, categorized under image and graphic design, which encompasses collaborative whiteboard functionality, diagram generation, sticky note synthesis, and noted considerations around creative IP risk. Miro is also present in the MCP server registry through two integrations: one enabling team collaboration on visual boards via a Miro integration, and another described as turning any live website into brand colors, fonts, design tokens, SVGs, Lottie animations, and paste-ready code. No litigation or SEC filings are recorded in the held facts.
